name: create_node_pool
description: Creates a node pool for a specific GKE cluster.

parameters.description: MCPCreateNodePoolRequest creates a node pool for a cluster.

nodePool.description: Required. The node pool to create represented as a string using JSON format. The full node pool object can be found at https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.clusters.nodePools

parent.description: Required. The parent (project, location, cluster name) where the node pool will be created. Specified in the format `projects/*/locations/*/clusters/*`.
